directions: Suppose your school is organizing an orientation program to help the freshmen adapt to the new environment and academic studies. You are now to write a proposal, which may include its aim, duration, participants and activities. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least llQ words but no more than 1Jj_Q words.
sample_essay:
To ensure that freshmen can smoothly adapt to the new environment and academic studies, I would like to propose an orientation program.

To begin with, the aim of this program is to help freshmen familiarize themselves with the campus layout, academic requirements, and campus culture. It will last for one week, starting from the day of registration. All the freshmen will be the participants.

In addition, a series of activities are planned. There will be campus tours led by senior students, during which freshmen can learn about different facilities on campus. Academic seminars will also be arranged, where professors will introduce the curriculum and learning methods. Moreover, group activities will be organized to promote communication among freshmen and help them make new friends.

In conclusion, this orientation program is expected to provide freshmen with a comprehensive understanding of the university and help them start their college life on the right foot. I hope this proposal can be considered and implemented.
